title: Levi bar Peitam
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot cite him, referring to Tanchuma, Pekudei 7: “Zavdi ben Levi and Levi bar Peitam,” etc. Hyman says they overlooked a textual error and that it should read as in Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1: “Zavdi ben Levi and Rabbi Yose bar Peitram.” Buber’s Tanchuma reads “Levi ben Peitam,” and the consulted Jerusalem Talmud reads “Rabbi Yosi bar Peitros.”

notes.text: The proposed change affects both the first name Levi/Yose and the patronym Peitam/Peitram. It remains Hyman’s correction.
